attempts.summary: Deployed a 3-node RabbitMQ 4.2.7 cluster on Alpine Linux nodes (node1/node2/node3) serving AMQP exclusively over TLS on 5671 (plain 5672 disabled), using a purpose-built cluster CA. The broker requires and verifies a client certificate issued by that CA (verify_peer + fail_if_no_peer_cert); unsigned/foreign certs and cert-less connections are rejected at the TLS layer. The management HTTP API (15672) is restricted via iptables to only the three cluster node IPs, with the rule set persisted via the iptables OpenRC service. Verified end-to-end AMQP publish/consume over mutual TLS, tested cluster resilience by stopping/restarting a node while a quorum queue kept serving traffic under majority, and completed the mandatory one-at-a-time reboot protocol for all three nodes with confirmed boot-ID changes and full cluster/data/firewall recovery after each.
